reviews.text: Dr. Andy Nguyen and his team were so kind and gentle. So professional. So knowledgeable. We were in good hands getting my son's impacted wisdom teeth removed. I'm so grateful for their good work and warm dispositions. They were quick.
I have been taking my kids here for at least 12 years. The only front office person I can remember is the one still currently there, Clarissa. She is the most sweetest person.

Just had another great visit. Clarissa is seriously the sweetest and always makes me feel super comfortable. The place is spotless, which is a huge plus, and they're quick so I'm never stuck there all day.

Doctor Andy and his complete staff did an excellent job on my crown preparation. He was very gentle and I didn't feel pain during the anesthesia injection. He took time to explain the procedure. I highly recommend them.
Just a loving dentist office where I feel great. I've been visiting Doctor Andy's office — Andy, Clarissa, Dr. Sarah — they were all very great and nice. They treated me well.
The doctor knows how to work with my dental plan to give me results I love, and I am smiling again. I've been to several dentists before and this office is by far the best.
